title: Columbia University Taiwanese Graduate Student Association
content_html:
The Columbia University Taiwanese Graduate Student Association (TGSA) is a registered student organization at Columbia University, listed in the university’s official LionLink student organization directory under the abbreviation TGSA. The organization’s Facebook page uses the Chinese name 哥倫比亞大學台灣學生會 and the handle @columbiatgsa.

Beyond its LionLink registration and Facebook page, TGSA has a limited public-facing web presence. No dedicated website, Instagram account, or Linktree was identified in available first-party sources. Its relationship to the separately operating CUTSA (Columbia University Taiwanese Student Association) is not clarified in available sources.
